user_query: trass gmail that mentions shipBob or merchant support exclude term mgm limit results to last 2 months

intent.goal: find gmail messages about ShipBob or merchant support, excluding MGM mentions

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND datetime(u.created_time) >= datetime('now', '-2 months')
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%shipbob%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%shipbob%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%shipbob%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%merchant support%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%merchant support%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%merchant support%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%merchant%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%merchant%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%merchant%'
)
AND (
    g.subject NOT LIKE '%mgm%' AND g.body_snippet NOT LIKE '%mgm%' AND g.message_content NOT LIKE '%mgm%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;
